description: ROM Ali Spirit Power Invocation, Item Proximity Scanner, Object Inspector & 4-Direction Normalizer

routines.name: ali_spirit_power_invoke
routines.purpose: Invokes Spirit Power: Air call (state 0x16, anim 0x16) vs Ground summon (state 0x10, anim 0x10) with vertical impulse vz = 0x70000

routines.name: ali_item_proximity_scanner
routines.purpose: Scans 12x12 area for type 8 pickup entities, absorbs target into $FF1976, and returns carry clear

routines.name: ali_object_npc_inspector
routines.purpose: Evaluates 4-way probe box in front of Ali, verifies angle via 0xE338, and routes NPC 0x32, Save Book 0x20, Cutscene 0x94/0x96/0xBE, or Chest 0xB0 with SFX 0xA00264
